issues.description: `sys` is referenced in both mathimpl.py files without an `import sys` being added.
issues.detail: The diff adds `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` to `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` but only imports `sys` in `mathdecl.py`. If `sys` isn't already imported in those modules, this is a NameError at import time. Verify and add the import where needed.

issues.description: Indentation/placement of the version-gated registration in mathdecl.py is wrong-shape.
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block sits flush against `Math_unary`'s signatures list with no blank-line separator, and rebinds `Math_unary` to the decorator result rather than calling it as a bare statement. Use `infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` without reassignment, with proper PEP 8 spacing after the class.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-gate idioms across the patch; unify on `PYVERSION`.
issues.detail: Typing and impls use raw `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` while tests use `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)`. The codebase already exposes `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION` as the convention. Using two notations forces future maintainers to grep both. Standardize on `PYVERSION` everywhere.

issues.description: Test inputs copy-pasted from `test_exp` with a duplicate and no exp2-specific edge cases.
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` duplicates `-2` and `2` and exercises nothing distinctive about exp2 (`2**x`). Add integer powers (e.g., 0, 10, -53), a near-overflow value (~1024), and a negative-large/denormal case to verify the LLVM intrinsic matches CPython semantics.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline (and underline length is suspect).
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file`, and the RST underline may not match the title length. RST toolchains are picky about underline length. Add the newline, match the underline, and trim redundant body text.

issues.description: Version check is a proxy; `hasattr(math, 'exp2')` is the actual data.
issues.detail: CPython's `math.exp2` availability is fundamentally an attribute-existence question, not a Python-version question. `hasattr(math, 'exp2')` survives backports and vendored builds and reads as self-evident. The same gate is repeated across three sites, hinting the underlying registration could be data-driven rather than three branching call sites.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on REFUSE-AS-SUBMITTED with two P0 blockers: `sys` is referenced in both impl files without a visible `import sys`, and the version-gated registration in `mathdecl.py` is wedged into the class body without separation and rebinds `Math_unary` rather than calling the decorator as a bare statement. Beyond the blockers, the patch invents two spellings for the Python-version gate when `PYVERSION` already exists in the codebase, the test inputs were copy-pasted from `test_exp` (with a duplicate) and exercise no exp2-specific edges, and the RST release note lacks a trailing newline. The shape is right — small, scoped, gated, documented, tested — but execution needs another pass.
